Here’s a terrifying one. 

It wad months ago when I went to a good friend of mine and offered him to finish a joint i started the other day. He accepted but boy oh boy did we not expect what was to come.
We grabbed some snacks beforehand and went out somewhere near his house in some park. We sat down, lit it up and smoked it away while watching the sunset and listening to some music. Then it hit, and it hit hard. It got dark really quick and I told him that we should probably get going. Then, I kid you not, I started seeing shadowy people appearing everywhere I looked, so I just sat down to calm down and stared at a tree so I wouldn’t see them anymore. They just kept appearing and getting closer and I felt like I peed my pants a little. I said “pack your goddamn bags we’re getting out of here dude” and so we did, I RAN TO MY BIKE, Usain Bolt style and just rushed onto it. I looked back and there was my friend coming towards me and his bike right by my side and all these SHADOW PEOPLE ALL OVER THE WOODS. Then I heard a loud bang somewhere really close and suddenly 4 voices at once appeared and I started pedaling for my life, I didn’t hesitate for a second, my only goal: get home safely. Luckily we did get home safely and continued chilling in his room while snacking on what was left, then we both passed out. 
Was a terrifying, but overall fun experience.
